Title: Build 200,000 affordable homes a year
Summary: A Kenya Kwanza campaign pledge to expand affordable housing, financed in part by a housing levy.

Title: Give every household health cover
Title (fr): Assurer chaque foyer contre la maladie
Summary: A pledge to bring every Kenyan household under health insurance.

Title: Set up a fund for small traders
Title (fr): Créer un fonds pour les petits commerçants
Summary: The Hustler Fund: small, cheap loans for traders and small businesses.

Title: Halve the price of fertiliser
Title (fr): Réduire de moitié le prix des engrais
Summary: A pledge to subsidise fertiliser so farmers pay less for it.

Title: Hire more teachers
Summary: A pledge to close the shortage of teachers in public schools.

Title: Feed every pupil in Nairobi’s public primary schools
Title (fr): Nourrir chaque élève des écoles primaires publiques de Nairobi
Summary: A pledge of daily school meals for children in the county’s public primary schools.
